summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026): the Oct 3 DECLARATION date slipped to 'October', and LIBERTY Phase 3 came in positive on Sep 29 (VYD2311 better tolerated than an mRNA vaccine). The stock still fell ~12% that day and ~37% since. The setup is cheaper but riskier: a supportive DECLARATION safety/immunogenicity readout opens an Accelerated Approval BLA that has to beat PEMGARDA's Jun 29, 2027 EUA sunset. ⚠️ SURVIVAL: Q2 operating cash use was $85M in H1 against $160.1M cash at Jun 30 (~11 months), with $55M left on an ATM and going-concern language flagged in Q2 coverage. It stays on the board because the readout is days away and lands well inside the runway, and at ~$175M the market already prices failure. The cost is a 2% cap and a dip-only entry. Base cut from +150% to +80% (still above the lane's realized 30d P90 of +25.9%; written-Base bias +72.7pp). It assumes a clean DECLARATION plus BLA filing within ~1-3 months, retracing toward the Sep ~$1.07 level. แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 60-80%.

catalysts.name: DECLARATION pivotal topline — safety + immunogenicity (VYD2311)
catalysts.description: Placebo-controlled Phase 3 safety and immune-response readout, guided for October 2026 (slipped from end of Q3). If supportive, Invivyd plans an Accelerated Approval BLA with clinical-efficacy data kept blinded until after approval.

catalysts.name: LIBERTY Phase 3 — positive (Sep 29)
catalysts.description: VYD2311 showed fewer adverse events than an mRNA vaccine (56.5% vs 91.4% at day 6, p<0.0001) and ~2.5x neutralizing titers when combined. The stock still fell ~12% on the day.

catalysts.name: PEMGARDA EUA sunset
catalysts.description: PEMGARDA — the company's only revenue — loses its EUA on Jun 29, 2027. A VYD2311 approval must land before then to avoid a revenue cliff.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: $160.1M cash at Jun 30, 2026 against $85M of H1 operating cash use (~11 months of runway, under 12), $55M still available on the 2025 ATM, and going-concern language flagged in Q2 coverage. A raise around the BLA is likely regardless of the outcome.
Revenue cliff: PEMGARDA is the only revenue line, and its EUA terminates Jun 29, 2027. A delayed or rejected VYD2311 BLA leaves the company without a product.
Accelerated Approval on immunogenicity, with efficacy kept blinded, is a novel and contestable path. FDA could require unblinded efficacy first, which pushes the timeline past the EUA sunset.
The market sold off on a positive LIBERTY result (-12% on the day), a sign that good data alone isn't re-rating this name while financing risk is unresolved.
Sub-$1 share price adds continued-listing / reverse-split risk on top of the operating risks.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Cash-burning antibody company with an ATM and an EUA revenue cliff. Funding conditions directly set the cost of bridging to a BLA.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — Oct 28 hold is priced (~93%), but hot CPI keeps a further 2026 hike live. Small, cash-burning names have already absorbed most of this tape's damage, so a hold is mildly supportive and a surprise hike is the main macro tail.

postWin.note: Kodiak Sciences (KOD) jumped ~166-180% on its Sep 28, 2026 Phase 3 DAYBREAK topline win in wet AMD — a small-cap biotech binary Phase 3 win just weeks before IVVD's own readout, direct evidence 150%+ single-day moves still happen in this regime. Capricor's own +300% Dec 2025 Phase 3 win is a further (cross-sector) tail-upside reference, though IVVD's Q2 earnings-miss overhang argues for a more moderate outcome than either.

postLose.note: EyePoint Pharmaceuticals (EYPT) fell 71% in one day on Aug 17, 2026 when its Phase 3 LUGANO trial missed its primary endpoint in wet AMD — a small-cap biotech binary Phase 3 miss just one month before IVVD's own DECLARATION readout, the direct downside precedent for this exact type of imminent single-catalyst risk.
